verdict.rationale: The only refund-related evidence is the batch-settlement spec, which says buyers who commit escrowed funds 'retain defined refund and withdrawal semantics.' That is a protocol-level refund path, but it is limited to escrowed batch payments, and nothing documents an API or SDK call to initiate a refund on a completed order or to track its status. Missing for 10: a documented programmatic refund-initiation API for settled exact/upto payments, refund status tracking or reporting, facilitator or SDK refund support, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, refunds on agent-placed orders can be initiated and tracked programmatically

citations.quote: Escrow is explicit, limits are cryptographically signed, and buyers retain defined refund and withdrawal semantics.
